subject: Greenlight checkpoint — map lock, signature lane, and first-week ramp plan
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellardata.com>

Cc: Kate Liu <kate@stellardata.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: MAP + SOW ready for final review — sign window?

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the run-through this morning. Per our conversation I attached the latest MAP (MAP_v4.xlsx) and the SOW with the operational appendix. The evaluation plan is complete — two-week pilot, success metrics spelled out on tab "EvalMetrics".

We are targeting an enterprise sign window next week and would like to lock the signers and start date by the 22nd if possible. Can you confirm:
- who at Redwood needs to approve (names & roles)
- any final legal or procurement risks we should expect
- a firm signing slot (we can do morning PST)

If you can route internal approvals this week, we can push the DocuSign envelope on Thursday for a Friday internal signoff at your end.

Attachment: MAP_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_SDL_v3.pdf (draft)

Best,
Tom Reynolds
Head of Data Partnerships
Stellar Data, Inc.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 16:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP + SOW ready for final review — sign window?

Tom — thanks, that looks clean. Quick internal notes:
- Primary approvers: Rachel (Legal) and Monica (CS onboarding) for operational commitments; CFO sign will be required for the reserved capacity clause (> $100k commit).
- Legal needs 48 hours to review redlines; procurement will need final SOW PDF and the pricing appendix.
- Proposed signing slot: Tue 22 Mar 2028 09:30 PT (we can move earlier if needed).

Rachel / Monica — can you confirm you can turnaround redline review by EOD Friday 17th? If legal flags anything material, we'll need to push the DocuSign envelope.

Vivek
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + SOW ready for final review — sign window?

Vivek / Tom — reviewed and left two operational redlines in the SOW: 1) clarify data retention window in section 4.2 (we prefer 90 days by default), 2) add explicit SLA exclusions for 3rd-party plug-ins. Neither is deal-killer; I tracked changes in SOW_redline.pdf and added a quick comment in the MAP on the "Data" row.

If Stellar can accept the retention standard and the exclusion language, Legal signs off. We can prepare DocuSign as soon as Tom confirms.

Also: Monica, FYI — please queue the onboarding-outline.pptx so CS can slot preparatory sessions if the start date is confirmed.

-Rachel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_redline.pdf

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellardata.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Liu <kate@stellardata.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Mar 2028 11:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + SOW ready for final review — sign window?

Rachel / Vivek — thanks for the quick turn. We accept the 90-day retention and the SLA exclusion language is fine. Kate and I can sign the SOW on Tue 22 Mar — morning PT works.

A couple of operational asks to lock now so CS can prep:
- Target start date (first production traffic): Mon 3 Apr 2028
- Pilot cadence: 2-week pilot (3 Apr–16 Apr) with the following gating metrics: 99th pct latency < 350ms, token cost variance < 12% vs baseline, and no P1 incidents.
- Canary plan: we’ll start with 10% traffic for first 72 hours then 50% for the remainder of the pilot if stable.

I also dropped the HubSpot deal link in the email thread for internal tracking (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7234).

Tom
Head of Data Partnerships
Stellar Data, Inc.
